svg.title: The OVAT stack
svg.desc: Six layers: interfaces, configuration, agent engines, providers and tools, serving and runtime, Intel hardware. Telemetry reads the engines, serving and hardware alongside the stack. A plano gateway is optional and outside OVAT.

g.text: You start in the ovat CLI, or in the optional terminal UI.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: workflow.yml passes a strict schema, then the agent factory builds the agent.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: agent.type picks one of four engines to run the loop.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Engines call the LLM provider, document search, built-in tools and MCP servers.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The model is served by OVMS, or in-process by openvino_genai.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Both run on Intel hardware: the CPU, GPU or NPU.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Telemetry reads the engines, serving and hardware, and writes JSON Lines or a TUI page.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Optionally, a plano gateway in front of OVMS records OpenTelemetry spans.

text.style: font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Interfaces, config, engines, providers and tools, serving, hardware. Telemetry runs alongside.
